q: Your company purchases a new public domain (northwindtraders.com) and wants to add it to your Microsoft 365 organization. Before Microsoft 365 allows you to assign email addresses using this domain, you must verify that your organization owns it.  How does Microsoft 365 verify domain ownership?
options: By detecting a specific TXT record created in the domain's public DNS zone.
By contacting your domain registrar to manually transfer domain administrative rights to Microsoft.
By verifying that the Global Administrator's credit card matches the billing contact on the domain registrar account.
By submitting an official notarized domain registration certificate to Microsoft Support.
exp: By detecting a specific TXT record created in the domain's public DNS zone.

q: A newly hired employee needs access to Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint Online, but their account cannot send or receive email yet.  What must the administrator assign to the user account in the Microsoft 365 admin center to grant access to these services?
options: Personal Laptop Computer
Disable the user
Product License
Exchange Administrator Role
exp: Product License

q: An administrator is adding the custom domain adatum.com in the Microsoft 365 admin center. The company wants to make adatum.com the default email suffix for all new user accounts created in the tenant.  Which step must be completed before you can set adatum.com as the default domain?
options: Configure an SPF record in public DNS.
Assign an Enterprise E5 license to the global administrator.
Configure Azure AD Connect password writeback.
Complete the domain verification process in Microsoft 365.
exp: Complete the domain verification process in Microsoft 365.

q: An organization wants to automatically block sign-ins to Microsoft 365 from countries where the company has no employees. If a sign-in originates from an unauthorized country, access should be denied regardless of correct credentials.  Which feature should the administrator configure?
options: Conditional Access policy with a named location
Disable user accounts for anyone traveling to unauthorized countries
Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR)
Microsoft Entra ID > Users > Blocked users list
exp: Conditional Access policy with a named location

q: An organization requires technicians to type a reason whenever they activate a privileged role in PIM for auditing purposes.  Which setting should be enabled in PIM?
options: Require justification
Require approval
Require password change
Require MFA
exp: Require justification

q: An administrator deletes a Microsoft 365 group named 'Project Alpha' from the Microsoft 365 admin center.  What happens to the resources associated with this group?
options: The shared mailbox is automatically converted to a user mailbox and the group's owner gets full access to all of the data.
The group is deleted permanently and all associated data is immediately purged.
The group and all associated resources — mailbox, SharePoint site, Teams, and files — are soft-deleted and can be restored within 30 days.
The group and all associated data are permanently preserved in a read-only state.
exp: The group and all associated resources — mailbox, SharePoint site, Teams, and files — are soft-deleted and can be restored within 30 days.

q: An administrator is configuring PIM for the Global Administrator role. To prevent unauthorized access, a manager must approve the user's request before the role is activated.  Which setting should be enabled in PIM?
options: Require password change
Auto-assign
Permanent access
Require approval
exp: Require approval

q: An administrator creates a distribution list named all-sales@contoso.com with 30 members. A user sends an email to all-sales@contoso.com.  What happens to the message?
options: The message is stored in a shared mailbox and members must open it manually.
A copy of the message is delivered to each member's individual mailbox.
The message is stored in a central queue and members receive a notification to view it.
Only the distribution list owner receives the message and must forward it to members
exp: A copy of the message is delivered to each member's individual mailbox.

q: Your organization is preparing for upcoming major feature rollouts in Microsoft 365. The IT Lead requests that early updates be tested by a designated group of early adopters before the general workforce receives them.  What is the direct effect of adding a user to the Targeted release for select users list in the Microsoft 365 admin center?
options: The user is automatically granted administrative access to the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.
The user is automatically assigned an Office Insider channel license for desktop Office apps.
The user receives early preview builds for Windows 11 Enterprise operating system updates.
The user gets early access to upcoming features across Microsoft 365 services.
exp: The user gets early access to upcoming features across Microsoft 365 services.

q: Which statement correctly describes the Global Administrator role and Microsoft's recommended security best practice for its assignment?
options: The Global Administrator role can only manage Exchange and SharePoint settings, and a tenant must have at least 10 accounts assigned this role.
The Global Administrator role grants unrestricted access to all tenant settings and data, and Microsoft recommends assigning it to no more than 2 to 4 accounts.
The Global Administrator role is automatically assigned to every user who holds a Microsoft 365 Enterprise E5 license
The Global Administrator role cannot reset passwords for other administrators or modify security policies.
exp: The Global Administrator role grants unrestricted access to all tenant settings and data, and Microsoft recommends assigning it to no more than 2 to 4 accounts.

q: You are configuring custom DNS records for contoso.com so Outlook desktop clients can automatically discover and connect to user mailboxes in Exchange Online.  Which CNAME record must you configure in your public DNS zone?
options: Exchange pointing to protection.outlook.com
Mail pointing to smtp.office365.com
Autodiscover pointing to autodiscover.outlook.com
Outlook pointing to portal.office.com
exp: Autodiscover pointing to autodiscover.outlook.com

q: Your company uses group-based licensing to assign Enterprise E5 licenses to a security group named 'Finance Team'. Due to compliance regulations, the Exchange Online service plan must be disabled for members of this group, while keeping all other E5 services active.  Which method should the administrator use to enforce this requirement with the minimum amount of administrative effort?
options: Connect to Exchange Online PowerShell and run a manual disable script for each Finance team user.
Turn off the Exchange Online service plan directly within the licensing properties of the 'Finance Team' group.
Create a new custom security group for each user and assign individual licenses without Exchange Online.
Run a PowerShell script daily to disable Exchange Online on individual user profiles.
exp: Turn off the Exchange Online service plan directly within the licensing properties of the 'Finance Team' group.

q: An administrator is attempting to assign a Microsoft Entra directory role to an existing security group, but the group does not appear in the selection list. Which of the following is the reason why a Microsoft Entra role cannot be assigned to this group?
options: Microsoft Entra roles cannot be assigned to security groups, only to mail distribution lists.
The option 'Microsoft Entra roles can be assigned to the group' was set to 'No' during group creation and cannot be changed later.
The administrator must first toggle the 'Microsoft Entra roles can be assigned to the group' setting to 'Yes' in the group's properties before assigning the role.
The group has reached its maximum quota of 500 member accounts.
exp: The option 'Microsoft Entra roles can be assigned to the group' was set to 'No' during group creation and cannot be changed later.

q: An administrator needs to create 150 new user accounts simultaneously in Microsoft 365 using the Bulk create users option in the admin center.  Which file format and requirement must be used to perform this bulk creation successfully?
options: An HTML file containing user schema definitions and clear-text passwords.
A Word document containing a bulleted table of user attributes and assigned license types.
A CSV file formatted using the official Microsoft template, containing required headers like User Name and Display Name.
A PDF document generated from an organizational HR portal containing employee profiles.
exp: A CSV file formatted using the official Microsoft template, containing required headers like User Name and Display Name.

q: Your organization recently adopted group-based licensing. You assign a Microsoft 365 E5 license to the 'Sales Department' security group. A user in the Sales department already has a Microsoft 365 E5 license directly assigned to their individual user account.  What happens to the user's license consumption and access state after being added to the licensed security group?
options: The system throws a license conflict error and revokes both assignments.
The user is charged for two licenses until the direct assignment is manually removed.
The direct license assignment is automatically deleted by Microsoft Entra ID
The user consumes only one Microsoft 365 E5 license, with the group assignment running alongside the direct assignment.
exp: The user consumes only one Microsoft 365 E5 license, with the group assignment running alongside the direct assignment.

q: An IT support technician needs to manage custom domain names and verify DNS settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Following the principle of least privilege, which administrative role should be assigned to the technician?
options: Domain Name Administrator
Global Administrator
User Administrator
Global Reader
exp: Domain Name Administrator

q: An administrator needs to create a group for the marketing department that provides a shared mailbox, a shared document library in SharePoint, and a team in Microsoft Teams — all automatically provisioned when the group is created.  Which group type should the administrator create?
options: Distribution list
Security group
Microsoft 365 group
Mail-enabled security group
exp: Microsoft 365 group

q: An organization creates a shared mailbox named info@contoso.com for customer service. Multiple representatives need to send emails that appear directly from info@contoso.com rather than on behalf of their individual accounts.  Following the principle of least privilege, which permission should the administrator assign?
options: Full Access
Send As
Owner
Read and Manage
exp: Send As

q: A company has an existing on-premises Active Directory and wants to synchronize its user accounts and passwords to Microsoft Entra ID so users can sign in to Microsoft 365 with their corporate credentials.  Which tool must the administrator deploy to synchronize identities from on-premises to the cloud?
options: System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM)
Azure ExpressRoute
Remote Desktop Services (RDS)
Microsoft Entra Connect
exp: Microsoft Entra Connect

q: An organization has experienced multiple incidents where employees' passwords were stolen through phishing emails. After entering the stolen password, attackers were able to sign in and access company data.  Which feature would prevent attackers from accessing accounts even if they obtain a user's password?
options: Password expiration policy
BitLocker encryption
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
Longer password requirements
exp: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

q: Your finance team requests that monthly billing statements, invoice notifications, and license renewal alerts be sent directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), who does not manage day-to-day user creation or directory objects.  Which role should be assigned to the CFO to grant access to billing communications and invoices with the least administrative effort?
options: Billing Administrator
User Administrator
Manually create a custom admin role for billing tasks.
Global Administrator
exp: Billing Administrator

q: An administrator wants to reduce standing admin privileges across the organization. Instead of giving a technician permanent Global Administrator rights, the administrator wants the technician to perform administrative tasks only when needed by requesting access.  Which type of assignment should the administrator configure in Privileged Identity Management (PIM)?
options: Permanent assignment
Eligible assignment
Group-based assignment
Active assignment
exp: Eligible assignment

q: Your organization operates an internal IT helpdesk. You want to ensure that when end users click the Help/Support options inside Microsoft 365 apps, they see your internal helpdesk contact information (phone number, support email, and helpdesk portal URL) instead of default Microsoft support links.  Where in the Microsoft 365 admin center should you configure these custom support details?
options: Org settings > Organization profile > Helpdesk information
Setup > Support preferences
Org settings > Services > Microsoft Support
Org settings > Security & privacy > Helpdesk contact
exp: Org settings > Organization profile > Helpdesk information

q: An administrator accidentally deletes a user account (user1@contoso.com) in the Microsoft 365 admin center. The user account held an active Exchange Online mailbox and OneDrive for Business data. 18 days after deletion, the user returns to work and requires full restoration of their account and data.  What action should the administrator take to restore the account and its associated data with the minimum administrative effort?
options: Restore the account directly from the Deleted users page in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
Reboot the local domain controller to trigger an automatic directory database roll-back.
Open a high-priority service request with Microsoft Support to restore the account.
Create a new user account with the same User Principal Name (UPN) and accept that all prior mailbox and OneDrive data is permanently unrecoverable.
exp: Restore the account directly from the Deleted users page in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

q: You are adding a new domain (contoso.com) to your Microsoft 365 tenant. To prove that you own the domain, Microsoft 365 provides a verification code formatted as MS=ms12345678.  Which DNS record should you create at your domain registrar to complete domain verification?
options: An SRV record pointing to _mscheck.contoso.com
A CNAME record pointing contoso.com to verify.microsoft.com
An MX record pointing to ms12345678.outlook.com
A TXT record containing the MS=ms12345678 text string
exp: A TXT record containing the MS=ms12345678 text string

q: An administrator is setting up a newly registered custom domain (contoso.com) in Microsoft 365 and needs to configure the required DNS records at the domain registrar.  Which DNS record type must be created so external mail servers can locate the domain's mail server and deliver email messages to @contoso.com?
options: NS Record
PTR Record
A Record
MX Record
exp: MX Record

q: An administrator wants to release new Microsoft 365 features to a select group of IT users before deploying them to the entire company. Which combination of release settings represents Microsoft's recommended best practice?
options: Deploy a Microsoft 365 Apps Preview channel via Intune and disable Standard release for the tenant.
Enable the Windows Insider program for the IT users.
Standard release for everyone and Targeted release for selected IT users.
Targeted release for everyone and Standard release for IT users.
exp: Standard release for everyone and Targeted release for selected IT users.

q: An administrator needs to ensure that when eligible users activate their administrative roles in PIM, they provide a documented business reason for auditing and compliance tracking.  Which requirement should be enabled in the PIM role activation settings?
options: Require Conditional Access policy compliance
Require MFA on activation
Require approval to activate
Require justification on activation
exp: Require justification on activation

q: An organization enforces Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for all users. A user has just received a new phone and can no longer receive MFA prompts.  Where should the administrator reset the user's authentication methods?
options: Microsoft Entra admin center > Security > Conditional Access.
Microsoft Teams admin center > Users > Security settings.
Microsoft Entra admin center > Users > Authentication method.
Microsoft 365 admin center > Org settings > Security & privacy.
exp: Microsoft Entra admin center > Users > Authentication method.

q: Your company uses group-based licensing to assign Enterprise E5 licenses to a security group named 'Finance Team'. Due to compliance regulations, the Exchange Online service plan must be disabled for members of this group, while keeping all other E5 services active.  Which method should the administrator use to enforce this requirement with the minimum amount of administrative effort?
options: Create a new custom security group for each user and assign individual licenses without Exchange Online.
Turn off the Exchange Online service plan directly within the licensing properties of the 'Finance Team' group.
Connect to Exchange Online PowerShell and run a manual disable script for each Finance team user.
Run a PowerShell script daily to disable Exchange Online on individual user profiles.
exp: Turn off the Exchange Online service plan directly within the licensing properties of the 'Finance Team' group.

q: A company has 200 Microsoft 365 Enterprise E3 licenses. The IT team wants to purchase 15 additional E3 licenses to accommodate new hires starting next month.  Which administrative role provides the minimal privileges required (least privilege) to purchase these licenses directly in the Microsoft 365 admin center?
options: Global Reader
Copilot (AI) Administrator
Billing Administrator
Global Administrator
exp: Billing Administrator

q: A helpdesk specialist needs to reset passwords, unblock sign-ins, and manage licenses for non-administrator users only. They should not be able to delete Global Administrators or modify tenant billing settings. Which role should be assigned?
options: Teams Administrator
Helpdesk Administrator
Billing Administrator
Global Reader
exp: Helpdesk Administrator

q: An administrator transitions an enterprise from manual license management to group-based licensing. After assigning Microsoft 365 E3 licenses to the 'All Employees' security group, the administrator wants to clean up direct license assignments without interrupting service for existing users.  What happens when the administrator removes a direct license assignment from a user who is also a member of the licensed security group?
options: The user is automatically removed from the 'All Employees' security group.
The user experiences no interruption to service access as the group assignment covers the license.
The user loses access to Microsoft 365 services for up to 24 hours while membership repopulates.
The user's account is placed in a soft-deleted state until re-licensed.
exp: The user experiences no interruption to service access as the group assignment covers the license.

q: An executive assistant needs to manage the CEO's mailbox — reading, replying, and organizing emails. When the assistant sends a reply, it should appear as coming directly from the CEO's email address with no indication that someone else sent it.  Which combination of permissions should the administrator assign?
options: Send on Behalf only
Full Access and Send on Behalf
Full Access and Send As
Send As only
exp: Full Access and Send As

q: Your organization is preparing for upcoming major feature rollouts in Microsoft 365. The IT Lead requests that early updates be tested by a designated group of early adopters before the general workforce receives them.  What is the direct effect of adding a user to the Targeted release for select users list in the Microsoft 365 admin center?
options: The user is automatically assigned an Office Insider channel license for desktop Office apps.
The user gets early access to upcoming features across Microsoft 365 services.
The user receives early preview builds for Windows 11 Enterprise operating system updates.
The user is automatically granted administrative access to the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.
exp: The user gets early access to upcoming features across Microsoft 365 services.

q: A company has an existing on-premises Active Directory and wants to synchronize its user accounts and passwords to Microsoft Entra ID so users can sign in to Microsoft 365 with their corporate credentials.  Which tool must the administrator deploy to synchronize identities from on-premises to the cloud?
options: Microsoft Entra Connect
Azure ExpressRoute
Remote Desktop Services (RDS)
System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM)
exp: Microsoft Entra Connect

q: An administrator successfully verifies 'contoso.com' in the Microsoft 365 admin center by adding a TXT record at the domain registrar. Two weeks later, a colleague accidentally deletes the TXT verification record from the public DNS zone.  What is the impact on the domain's status in the Microsoft 365 tenant?
options: Email delivery for all users on the domain stops until the TXT record is re-created.
All user accounts using the domain are immediately switched to the onmicrosoft.com fallback domain.
The domain is automatically removed from the tenant within 24 hours.
The domain remains verified and functional in the tenant; the TXT record is only required during the initial verification process.
exp: The domain remains verified and functional in the tenant; the TXT record is only required during the initial verification process.

q: An organization wants to implement Just-In-Time (JIT) administrative access so that employees only get administrative permissions for a limited time when needed.  Which feature in Microsoft Entra should the administrator use?
options: Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR)
Conditional Access
Identity Protection
Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
exp: Privileged Identity Management (PIM)

q: An administrator adds the domain 'Johnbryce.co.il' to a Microsoft 365 environment.  What action is required to verify ownership of this domain name?
options: Create a unique TXT or MX verification record provided by Microsoft at the domain registrar.
No DNS verification is needed; the domain is verified automatically upon entry into the tenant.
Submit ownership documents via a Microsoft support ticket.
Assign an Enterprise E5 license to the domain before adding it to the admin center.
exp: Create a unique TXT or MX verification record provided by Microsoft at the domain registrar.

q: An organization wants to automatically block sign-ins to Microsoft 365 from countries where the company has no employees. If a sign-in originates from an unauthorized country, access should be denied regardless of correct credentials.  Which feature should the administrator configure?
options: Microsoft Entra ID > Users > Blocked users list
Conditional Access policy with a named location
Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR)
Disable user accounts for anyone traveling to unauthorized countries
exp: Conditional Access policy with a named location

q: An IT team hires a tier-1 helpdesk technician whose sole responsibility is to reset forgotten user passwords and manage user sign-in issues.  Following the principle of least privilege, which admin role in the Microsoft 365 admin center should be assigned to this technician?
options: Exchange Administrator
Global Reader
Helpdesk Administrator
User Administrator
exp: Helpdesk Administrator

q: What management capability is granted to a Group Owner regarding their specific Microsoft 365 group?
options: The group owner receives all licenses configured for the group.
The group owner can manage domain DNS records for the entire organization.
The group owner can manage group membership, add/remove members, and update group settings.
The group owner receives a copy of all emails sent to the group.
exp: The group owner can manage group membership, add/remove members, and update group settings.

q: A newly hired employee needs access to Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint Online, but their account cannot send or receive email yet.  What must the administrator assign to the user account in the Microsoft 365 admin center to grant access to these services?
options: Product License
Disable the user
Personal Laptop Computer
Exchange Administrator Role
exp: Product License

q: A user account was deleted from a Microsoft 365 tenant 35 days ago. The IT Lead attempts to locate the deleted account in the Deleted users node of the Microsoft 365 admin center to restore it, but the account is no longer listed.  Why is the user account no longer visible in the Deleted users list?
options: The 30-day soft-delete retention period expired, causing the account to be permanently purged.
Soft-deleted user accounts are hidden from the admin center after 30 days and can only be viewed using Microsoft Graph API and PowerShell commands.
The account was automatically renamed after 30 days, requiring you to locate it using its new system-generated username.
The account was never deleted; it was automatically converted into a shared mailbox upon receiving the deletion request.
exp: The 30-day soft-delete retention period expired, causing the account to be permanently purged.

q: A shared mailbox (info@contoso.com) has reached its 50 GB storage limit. The administrator needs to increase its storage capacity beyond the default limit.  What must the administrator do to increase the shared mailbox storage?
options: Contact Microsoft Support to request a one-time storage extension.
Assign a Microsoft 365 license to the shared mailbox to increase its storage quota.
Delete old emails to free up space — shared mailboxes cannot exceed 50 GB under any circumstances.
Convert the shared mailbox to a distribution list, which has unlimited storage.
exp: Assign a Microsoft 365 license to the shared mailbox to increase its storage quota.

q: A project manager needs to share documents and collaborate in Microsoft Teams with an external consultant who does not have an account in the organization's tenant.  How should the administrator provide the consultant access to the project's Microsoft 365 group?
options: Invite the consultant as a guest user and add them to the group.
Share the group password with the consultant via email.
Forward all group emails to the consultant's personal email address.
Export group files to a USB drive and send them to the consultant.
exp: Invite the consultant as a guest user and add them to the group.

q: An organization deploys Microsoft Entra Connect to synchronize its on-premises Active Directory with Microsoft Entra ID. After the initial sync completes successfully, the administrator reviews the Microsoft 365 admin center.  What data has been synchronized from on-premises to the cloud?
options: User accounts and their assigned on-premises file server permissions.
User accounts, group memberships, and other directory attributes such as job title and department.
Only security group names without their members.
Only user email addresses and passwords.
exp: User accounts, group memberships, and other directory attributes such as job title and department.

q: Your company wants to apply corporate branding across the top navigation bar of Microsoft 365 for all users. Requirements specify displaying the corporate logo, custom background colors, and an image that redirects users to the internal intranet when clicked.  Which feature in the Microsoft 365 admin center under Org settings > Organization profile fulfills this requirement?
options: Custom themes
Organization information
Multitenant collaboration
Organizational profile cards
exp: Custom themes

q: An IT administrator wants to ensure that a technician does not have permanent administrator permissions all the time, but can activate the role when needed.  What type of role assignment should be configured in PIM?
options: Visitor
Guest
Permanent
Eligible
exp: Eligible

q: An organization wants to enforce a policy that requires users to provide a secondary form of verification — such as an authenticator app notification or text message code — when signing in from outside the corporate network.  Which feature should the administrator configure to enforce this requirement?
options: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR)
Domain Name System (DNS)
Password Expiration Policy
exp: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
